title: 第30章 她香了，肉香
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
甚至因为身上所穿衣物皆是天阶法宝，雷劫过后她仍是光鲜亮丽的样子，只是发丝略显凌乱。

    老祖一行人在旁边看到这幕，啧啧称奇：

    “归鸿小子，我这小徒孙可比你厉害多了，这么粗的劫雷劈完，你怕是连站都站不住，小徒孙可还安安稳稳的站着，果真是厉害。”老祖感叹道。

    想他活了这么多年，也是第一次见到练气期修士敢硬抗合体期雷劫。

    小徒孙不仅家世背景硬，自己也是梆梆硬啊！

    “微生小姐果真是天资卓绝，如此恐怖的雷劫，要是我的话，现在估计就成灰了。”

    谢家主擦拭一番额头上的汗水，他以后再也不说微生小姐脾气嚣张了。

    要是他能有硬抗合体期雷劫的实力，他觉得自己会比微生小姐还嚣张。

    毕竟在修仙界里，强者为尊。

    只要你有那个实力，再嚣张别人也奈何不了你，遇到不顺心的，杀了便是。

    尤其是像微生小姐这般含着金汤匙出生的人，一出生就拥有了对他人生杀予伐的权利，从小的生活环境里更是无人敢忤逆她。

    再加上本身天赋出众，她现在这样的性子，已经算是极好。

    要是真遇上个刁蛮的，那才是连解释的机会都没有，死都死不明白。

    濮阳明珠混迹在人群中，听着他们对自己小师妹的惊叹，毫不意外。

    自家小师妹就是这样，天资卓绝，是举世难寻的天才。

    也就是他们没见识，才会这般惊呼。

    不像她，早早就知道了自家师妹的厉害。

    对面，咬牙硬扛过第一道天雷后，微生璃月抬眸一看，远处齐溜溜站了一排，全在围观她挨雷劈。

    就连将这雷劫引来的始作俑者也混迹其中，一边吃着她的瓜，一边还看自己替他挨雷劈，好不公平。

    如果不是要维持高傲且天资卓绝的人设，微生璃月真想过去把那老头薅过来跟自己一起挨劈。

    可惜微生璃月这个念头并没有持续多久，因为那该死的劫雷又来了。

    这下不仅是便宜老头的劫雷，其他几个师兄师姐的劫雷都开始往她这边跑。
content_en:
Even because the clothes she wore were all heaven-level magic weapons, she still looked bright and beautiful after the thunderstorm, but her hair was slightly messy.

The ancestor and his group saw this scene and were amazed:

"Guihong boy, my little disciple is much more powerful than you. After such a thick thunderbolt strikes, you may not even be able to stand, but my little disciple is still standing safely. It's really amazing." The ancestor sighed.

Thinking that he has lived for so many years, this is the first time he has seen a monk in the Qi training stage dare to resist the thunder tribulation in the integration stage.

Not only does the young disciple have a tough family background, but he himself is also tough!

"Miss Weisheng is indeed extremely talented. Such a terrifying thunder catastrophe, if it were me, I would probably be reduced to ashes by now."

The head of the Xie family wiped the sweat from his forehead. He would never say that Miss Weisheng had an arrogant temper again.

If he had the strength to withstand the thunder tribulation of the combined stage, he felt that he would be more arrogant than Miss Wei Sheng.

After all, in the world of immortality, the strong are respected.

As long as you have that strength, no matter how arrogant you are, others can't do anything to you. If you encounter someone who doesn't like you, just kill them.

Especially for people like Miss Weisheng, who was born with a silver spoon in her mouth, she had the right to kill others as soon as she was born. No one dared to disobey her in her childhood living environment.

Coupled with her outstanding talent, her current temperament is already considered excellent.

If you really meet an unruly person, you won't even have a chance to explain, and you will die without understanding.

Puyang Mingzhu mingled among the crowd and was not surprised to hear their admiration for his little junior sister.

My little junior sister is like this, she is extremely talented and is a genius that is hard to find in the world.

That's why they exclaimed like this because they were ignorant.

Unlike her, she knew how powerful her junior sister was early on.

On the opposite side, after gritting her teeth and enduring the first thunder, Weisheng Liyue raised her eyes and saw a row of people standing in the distance, all watching her being struck by lightning.

Even the person who caused this lightning disaster was among them. While eating her melon, she thought it was unfair that she was struck by lightning on his behalf.

If she didn't want to maintain her arrogant and talented persona, Weisheng Liyue would have really wanted to go over and bring the old man over to be beaten with her.

It's a pity that the idea of ​​Weisheng Liyue didn't last long, because the damn thunder came again.

Now, not only the cheap old man's robbery, but also the robbery of several other senior brothers and sisters began to run towards her.
title_en: Chapter 30 She smells good, meat smells good
